style: Square 1:1 hero portrait icon for VELSTRIA, a premium fantasy mobile MOBA game. Hand-painted splash-art quality: painterly semi-realistic digital painting, crisp detail, dramatic rim lighting and strong value contrast so the character reads clearly even at very small icon sizes. Tight head-and-shoulders close-up: the face (or helmet / mask) is large and placed slightly above the center, the top of the head close to the top edge, shoulders and the signature weapon partially visible. 3/4 view toward the viewer, confident expression. Background: deep starry cosmic nebula tinted {background}, soft bokeh, a subtle glow behind the character. Tasteful all-ages costume design for a 9+ rated game: no cleavage, no bare chest or midriff on female characters, no revealing outfits. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos, signature, watermark, border, frame or UI elements. Full-bleed square image; keep the bottom-right corner free of important detail (a small badge is overlaid there).
skin_style: Use the attached image as the identity reference: the SAME character (same face, species, body type, hairstyle silhouette and signature weapon type), the same tight head-and-shoulders framing, camera angle and painterly art style. Redesign only the costume, armor materials, colors and magical effects as the alternate skin described below. Background: deep starry cosmic nebula tinted {background}. Tasteful all-ages costume design for a 9+ rated game: no cleavage, no bare chest or midriff on female characters, no revealing outfits. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos, signature, watermark, border, frame or UI elements. Full-bleed square image; keep the bottom-right corner free of important detail.

heroes.name: Alden
heroes.description: Alden, the Gate Oathguard: a stalwart male knight with a stern weathered face, short brown beard and determined eyes, wearing an open-faced silver knight helmet. Heavy polished silver plate armor with big rounded pauldrons, golden-amber enamel armor panels and sky-blue trims, a heavy cape. He braces a massive tower shield shaped like a fortified castle gate (portcullis motif) and holds a broad-bladed longsword. Warm golden holy light glints on the steel.

heroes.name: Lyra
heroes.description: Lyra of the Star Strings: an agile young female duelist with pale blonde hair in a high ponytail and a small golden star-shaped hairpin. Light elegant armor in spring-green with gold trims and a flowing sash. She holds a slender star-tipped rapier and carries a harp-shaped bow strung with glowing aqua strings; tiny aqua star motes float around her.

heroes.name: Kael
heroes.description: Kael of the Ash Blade: a lean, sharp-eyed male ranger with tanned skin and short ash-grey hair under a dark leather hood, a scarf around his neck. Jade-green leather ranger armor with iron buckles and ember-orange trims, a quiver of arrows on his back. He draws a recurve bow whose limbs are blackened ash-steel blades, the nocked arrow glowing with smoldering ember-orange fire and drifting ash.

heroes.name: Mirea
heroes.description: Mirea the Tide Prayer: a graceful female sea mage with long flowing deep ocean-blue hair and a delicate silver crown made of seashells and pearls. Modest high-collared azure-blue layered robes covering the shoulders and chest, with coral-pink trims. She holds a tall silver staff crowned with a swirling wave, and a glowing aqua sphere of water floats beside her hand, droplets orbiting it.

heroes.name: Voss
heroes.description: Voss of the Black Thunder: a gaunt, intense male storm mage with pale skin and spiky white hair, eyes crackling with violet light. Indigo robes with obsidian-black crystal shoulder pieces and a tattered dark cape. He grips a jagged obsidian spear wreathed in violet lightning, and a ring of violet lightning (a halo of electricity) hovers behind his head.

heroes.name: Seren
heroes.description: Seren of the Moon Lantern: a slim, mysterious female assassin wearing a close hood and a cloth mask covering the lower half of her face, only her calm lavender eyes visible; strands of lavender-silver hair and a silver crescent-moon hairpin. Dark orchid-magenta leather outfit with long scarf tails. She holds a silver crescent-moon dagger and a small lantern that glows with pale golden moonlight.

heroes.name: Garruk
heroes.description: Garruk of the Rock Vein: a towering, muscular male brute with tanned skin, a dark reddish-brown mohawk, a thick braided beard and a cloth headband. His armor is made of rough stone slabs with huge boulder shoulder guards and crimson-rose cloth wraps. Both fists are encased in enormous rock gauntlets split by glowing molten-orange cracks, embers rising.

heroes.name: Nia
heroes.description: Nia of the Wind Banner: a spirited young female duelist with short windswept auburn hair and a feather hairpin. Light tangerine-orange armor with feathered shoulder pieces and teal trims, long teal wind ribbons fluttering behind her. She wields a silver spear that carries a long flowing banner, swirling teal wind currents around the spearhead.

heroes.name: Orin
heroes.description: Orin the Artificer: a clever male engineer with tanned skin, short brown hair and brass goggles pushed up on his forehead, a confident grin. Mechanical brass armor with chartreuse-green panels and copper-orange trims, a gear-laden backpack with small cogs. His left arm is a full brass mechanical prosthetic; he shoulders a heavy repeating mechanical crossbow, its bolts glowing amber.

heroes.name: Thessa
heroes.description: Thessa of the Flame Crown: a fierce female fire sorceress with long fiery red hair and a golden crown made of living flames above her brow. Emerald-green robes with gold embroidery and orange trims. One hand holds an open golden-bound grimoire, the other blazes with roaring orange fire, and several small fireballs orbit around her.

heroes.name: Rook
heroes.description: Rook of the Iron Wings: a steadfast male guardian-priest with tanned skin and short dark slate hair, wearing an iron half-visor over his eyes. Iron plate armor with rounded pauldrons and turquoise-cyan panels, large mechanical iron wings folded behind his back. He holds a tall aegis staff topped with a protective lantern that glows soft cyan light.

heroes.name: Elyne
heroes.description: Elyne of the Glass Song: a slender, pale female assassin with a sleek icy pale-blue bob haircut and a translucent glass visor over her eyes. Royal-blue light armor with sharp crystal shoulder pieces and scarf tails. She holds twin daggers made of clear glass, and razor-thin glass shards float around her, refracting pale cyan light like a frozen melody.

heroes.name: Dagan
heroes.description: Dagan of the Beast Mark: a massive male tribal warrior with deep dark skin and wild dark-brown hair, wearing the bleached skull mask of a great horned beast over the top of his head, his fierce eyes visible below it. Fur and leather armor with heavy fur pauldrons and a fur cape, purple war paint and glowing red tribal carvings on his skin. He holds a huge bone club and a round hide-and-bone shield.

heroes.name: Sio
heroes.description: Sio the Mist Walker: a lean, calm young male swordsman with near-black navy hair tied in a high topknot with a pale ribbon. Rose-pink and white layered cloth garb with a long hooded mist cloak whose edges dissolve into drifting fog. He holds a slim katana trailing pale blue mist in one hand and a short blade in the other.

heroes.name: Valka
heroes.description: Valka of the War Bell: a bold female gunner with golden blonde braids under a bronze viking helmet with small wings. Orange leather armor with rounded bronze pauldrons. She shoulders a heavy bronze hand-cannon (blunderbuss) whose muzzle flares out like a bell, a large bronze war bell strapped on her back, warm golden sparks.

heroes.name: Iris
heroes.description: Iris of the White Halo: a serene young female arcanist with long flowing silver-white hair and a slender golden circlet on her forehead. Layered white robes with pale lime-green panels and gold trim. She holds a tall golden staff topped with a glowing ring, and a large softly glowing white halo floats behind her head.

heroes.name: Mord
heroes.description: Mord of the Abyss Chain: an ominous male occultist with ashen grey skin, his face hidden in the shadow of a deep hood and a dark mask, only two glowing violet eyes visible. Dark green and black robes with a tattered cape. He swings a smoking iron censer lantern on a chain, and spectral chains glowing violet float and coil around him.

heroes.name: Celia
heroes.description: Celia of the Flower Star: a petite, graceful female assassin with a pink bob haircut, a crown of flowers and a golden crescent hairpin. Mint-teal cloth outfit with a skirt of layered flower petals and golden accents. She holds twin curved blades shaped like flower petals, and pink blossom petals swirl around her.

heroes.name: Bram
heroes.description: Bram the Fortress Breaker: a hulking male warrior in a heavy iron helmet with two great curved horns, his scarred tanned jaw and fierce eyes visible. Massive iron plate armor with huge pauldrons and cobalt-blue panels, orange trims. He rests an enormous iron siege hammer on his shoulder, its head glowing with orange heat.

heroes.name: Yuna
heroes.description: Yuna of the Light Arrow: an energetic young female duelist with golden blonde twin tails tied with ribbons. Light violet-and-gold armor. She wields a radiant blade forged from a giant arrow of light and carries a golden bow; motes of warm golden light trail around her.

heroes.name: Kiros
heroes.description: Kiros of the Time Sand: a calm male sharpshooter with tanned skin, short sandy-brown hair and a wide-brimmed hat, a scarf around his neck. Long fuchsia-magenta leather coat with brass buckles. He holds a long ornate brass rifle, and a glowing hourglass floats beside him with golden sand swirling out of it.

heroes.name: Rhea
heroes.description: Rhea of the Azure Claw: a wild female fox-eared mage with untamed icy pale-blue hair and fox ears. Vermilion-red robes with silver trims. Both hands are fitted with long glowing azure crystal claws, and azure claw-shaped crystals float around her, crackling with blue arcane energy.

heroes.name: Toren
heroes.description: Toren of the Thunder Lance: a noble male lancer with tanned skin and short dark-brown hair, wearing a silver winged helmet. Silver plate armor with rounded pauldrons and golden-yellow panels, bright blue trims, a cape. He holds a long silver lance crackling with blue-white lightning, and a sphere of lightning hovers near him.

heroes.name: Noa
heroes.description: Noa the Dream Weaver: a dreamy, playful female assassin with a lavender bob haircut, a floppy nightcap and a silver crescent hairpin, half-lidded eyes. A cozy high-necked light-green and lilac cloth outfit with long sleeves (shoulders and chest covered). She holds twin long silver needles like stilettos, and glowing violet dream threads weave and float around her.

skins.name: Starforged Alden
skins.description: Starforged skin: armor re-forged from star metal — deep royal-blue armor panels with gold metal plating instead of silver, constellation engravings across the shield and pauldrons, faint starlight glimmering on the sword.

skins.name: Eclipse Sentinel Alden
skins.description: Eclipse Sentinel skin: blackened obsidian plate armor with gold trims, the gate shield bearing a solar-eclipse emblem with a ring of golden corona light, a dark cape; brooding night atmosphere.

skins.name: Aurora Citadel Alden
skins.description: Aurora Citadel skin: gleaming white and platinum armor with gold filigree, the gate shield shaped like a radiant crystal citadel, ribbons of aqua aurora light flowing around him.

skins.name: Obsidian Giant Garruk
skins.description: Obsidian Giant skin (Epic): his rock armor and gauntlets become glossy black volcanic obsidian glass with sharp faceted edges, veins of glowing teal energy, gold bands on the gauntlets, a powerful teal aura around him. More ornate and imposing than the base design.

skins.name: Lava Vein Garruk
skins.description: Lava Vein skin (Epic): charred black basalt armor and gauntlets split by rivers of bright molten lava, dripping magma and rising embers, gold accents, a fiery aura. More ornate and imposing than the base design.

skins.name: Crystal Colossus Garruk
skins.description: Crystal Colossus skin (Epic): armor and gauntlets made of translucent white and pale-blue quartz crystal clusters, platinum and gold bands, glowing aqua light refracting through the crystals, a shimmering aura. More ornate and imposing than the base design.

skins.name: Frostfang Dagan
skins.description: Frostfang skin: the beast mask becomes the skull of a frost wolf with icy fangs, white snow-fur pauldrons and cape, frost-covered bone club and shield, glowing icy-blue tribal marks, falling snow.

skins.name: Emberclad Dagan
skins.description: Emberclad skin: charred black fur and scorched bone armor with gold accents, smoldering ember-orange cracks in the bone club and mask, drifting sparks and glowing orange tribal marks.

skins.name: Celestial Beast Dagan
skins.description: Celestial Beast skin: the mask becomes a radiant white-and-gold celestial beast skull, white fur trimmed with gold, the club and shield inlaid with platinum and glowing aqua runes, a soft heavenly glow.

skins.name: Iron Siege Bram
skins.description: Iron Siege skin (Epic): heavily riveted dark iron siege armor with amber-orange panels and brass gears, smoke and sparks, the siege hammer turned into a massive piston-driven battering ram hammer, a glowing amber aura. More ornate and imposing than the base design.

skins.name: Thunder Ram Bram
skins.description: Thunder Ram skin (Epic): blackened obsidian armor with gold trims, the horned helmet and siege hammer crackling with bright blue-white lightning bolts, storm clouds behind, an electric aura. More ornate and imposing than the base design.

skins.name: Starfall Breaker Bram
skins.background: cosmic white gold with falling meteors
skins.description: Starfall Breaker skin (Epic): radiant white and platinum armor with gold filigree, the siege hammer head forged from a glowing fallen star (meteorite) trailing aqua starlight, meteors streaking behind, a celestial aura. More ornate and imposing than the base design.
